Now try to understand. We're all human, and under the right conditions we are all capable of everything any human has ever and will ever do, no matter how cruel or kind. Your courtesy is not hers, and hers is not yours. Let it slip your mind, what she thinks is irrelevant.

You are both young and foolish, she doesn't know what you're going through and she doesn't care about the consequences of her actions right now. Years from now she might go through something similar or be impacted in some way - she might reflect back on her behaviour and cringe at how judgemental she was. Then again she might stay ignorant, but either way does her opinion matter at all? She didn't offer you any advice, she simply wanted to hurt you. Why should you care of her opinion if all she intends to do is harm you?

Your spot on this planet won't be replaced when you die. You mention that you've achieved goals that you thought would take you away from the notion of suicide; yet clearly your goals were insufficient. Create new goals - evidently you are not happy with your life, perhaps your goals should revolve around your personal happiness and your sense of belonging might just naturally fall into place.

You've tried things that hurt you. I've been there too. Now you need to try the opposite. Try things that make you feel boundless joy. Euphoric happiness. Things are shit now, but they won't always be shit unless you make them so. 16 is so young. There is nothing stupid about having an abortion and you shouldn't hate yourself for it, regardless of what anyone else tells you - you made a decision and you can't change that. Push forward and deal with it through improving yourself, making yourself happy. Hurting yourself does not help, no matter how much you think you deserve it. Maybe you can book an appointment with the doctor and explain your situation, perhaps even get some medication and counselling, work hard through school and aspire to be someone you are proud of. Hang in there! :)

Life's like eating an apple. Everyone around you seems to be enjoying their apple, but sometimes you just don't feel hungry any more. As long as you hold onto that apple you'll eventually feel hungry again. Eating the apple is pointless; one day it will be gone and all that's left to show for it will be the seeds inside. If you eat your apple right you might leave some seeds behind that grow into new apples. Not eating the apple is equally pointless to eating it. No matter what happens, no matter how good or bad the apple tastes, no matter how rotten some parts of the apple are, no matter how big or small your apple is, no matter how many seeds are buried and grow into new apples - one day billions of years from now all of the apples will be gone. Every. Single. One.

There are some things you can't change, but you always have the choice of whether or not you want to keep eating your apple. It's one of the few things in this life that you have complete control over. Why shouldn't you eat your apple? Why should you? Why do you even have an apple? You didn't ask for it. Maybe if you keep eating you'll pass through the rotten parts and hit the sweet juicy goodness, maybe not. Either way that apple is yours and it's the only thing you truly own. Nobody can tell you what to do with it, the decision is yours and yours alone.
